title: 第171章 帮工第170章 任选
content_zh:
山匪头头嘴角抽搐，“太不把俺放在眼里了。”他抬手指向原先那个大爷，“你过来！”
好在韩正津这次没听岔，主动站到山匪头头面前。
“不见点血你们不知道俺的厉害。”山匪头头摩拳擦掌，露出鼻孔，“我谅你年纪大，让你一拳，回头别说俺欺负老人。”
“来，打我一拳！”
“行。”
韩正津横迈一步，鞋尖画圆，双手在胸前环绕一周，山匪头头隐隐看见个阴阳八卦图，还没来得及细看，整个人便飞出去老远。
我擦？？？
山匪头头飞出去时，他手底下的几个山匪完全没有反应过来。他们张大嘴，看着自己的老大在空中划出一道弧线，落在几丈外的草垛上，滚了两圈，然后趴在地上半天不动。
过了好半晌，他们才呼啦啦跑过去。
“二当家！二当家你没事吧？”
“二当家！”
“呜呜呜，二当家……”
“……”
几人七手八脚地把山匪头头扶起来。
山匪头头不是摔晕了，而是摔懵了，他难以置信地看着前面再普通不过的大爷，枯瘦如柴，整个人加起来都分量抵不上他一条腿。
“奶奶个胸！敢诈俺！”山匪头头一把推开几人，气势汹汹地走到韩正津面前。
“老东西，你是干什么的？力气这么大。”
韩正津把手背到身后，“俺以前是种田滴，后面地里收成不好，家里人都饿死了，便了却凡尘，上山为道。”
说得还挺惨，山匪头头不信。
“骗鬼呢？你说你上山为道，现在咋滴还在村里？你别告诉俺你家道观塌了，不得已跑到村里住。”

韩正津：“正是如此。”
山匪头头：“……”
“你他娘的……”
迷踪林深处。
姬伯以和魅妩一同进入一个露天洞穴。
进来之前，姬伯以将披散的头发用簪子束起，眼神示意魅妩，“待会进去别乱说话。”
魅妩点头应下。
“回来了。”前方的阴暗处，一个声音率先开口，那声音不男不女，听着发闷，在空间里回荡再传到耳朵里，很是奇怪扭曲。
魅妩跪倒在地，“回禀阁主，任务已圆满完成。”
“嗯。”那个声音再次响起，“护法留下，你先下去。”
“是。”
姬伯以抬手作揖，待适应洞里的光线后，才看清那边有个黑影背对自己坐着，面前是个棋盘。
此人便是沉渊阁阁主——落沉渊。
等了半天，落沉渊几次落子都不见问点什么，姬伯以等得无聊，干脆自己找话。
四下看看，“小怀柔跑哪去了？”
落沉渊终于开口：“问她做什么？”
“随便问问。”姬伯以扬了扬嘴角，“好久没见，有点想她了，下山时还顺手给她带了栗子饼。”
“临时有个任务。”落沉渊答了句，又问：“左护法怎么没跟你一起回来？”
“他有出去？”姬伯以懵了下，很快反应过来，“啧，他性子怪得很，我哪管得住他啊？”
落沉渊不语。

姬伯以：“小怀柔去哪出任务了？我去接她。”
“不用接，去送样东西。”落沉渊落下一子。
content_en:
The bandit leader's mouth twitched, "You don't take me seriously." He raised his hand and pointed at the old man, "Come here!"
Fortunately, Han Zhengjin didn't listen to him this time and took the initiative to stand in front of the bandit leader.
"You don't know how powerful I am without a little blood." The bandit leader rubbed his hands and exposed his nostrils, "I forgive you for being old. I'll give you a punch. Don't say that I bullied the old man later."
"Come on, punch me!"
"Okay."
Han Zhengjin took a step forward, made a circle with the toes of his shoes, and wrapped his hands around his chest. The bandit leader faintly saw a Yin-Yang Bagua diagram. Before he could take a closer look, he flew away far away.
Shall I wipe it? ? ?
When the bandit leader flew out, the bandits under him did not react at all. They opened their mouths wide and watched as their boss drew an arc in the air, landed on a haystack a few feet away, rolled twice, and then lay on the ground without moving for a long time.
After a long while, they ran over with a huff.
"Second Master! Second Master, are you okay?"
"Second Master!"
"Uuuuuuuuuuu, second boss..."
"..."
Several people scrambled to help the bandit leader up.
The bandit leader was not knocked out by the fall, but stunned. He looked at the ordinary old man in front of him in disbelief. He was as skinny as a stick, and his whole body was not as heavy as one of his legs.
"Grandma, you have such big breasts! How dare you deceive me!" The bandit leader pushed several people away and walked to Han Zhengjin aggressively.
"Old guy, what do you do? You are so strong."
Han Zhengjin put his hands behind his back, "I used to farm, but the harvest in the fields behind me was not good, and my family all starved to death, so I quit the world and went up the mountain as a way."
It was quite tragic, but the bandit leader didn't believe it.
"Are you lying? You said you went up the mountain to practice Taoism, but why are you still in the village now? Don't tell me that your Taoist temple collapsed and you had no choice but to live in the village."
Han Zhengjin: "That's right."
Bandit leader: "..."
"You fucking..."
Deep in the Lost Forest.
Ji Boyi and Mei Wu entered an open-air cave together.
Before coming in, Uncle Ji tied up his loose hair with a hairpin and signaled Mei Wu with his eyes, "Don't talk nonsense when you go in."
Mei Wu nodded in agreement.
"Back." In the darkness ahead, a voice spoke first. The voice was neither male nor female. It sounded muffled. It echoed in the space and then reached the ears. It was very strange and distorted.
Meiwu knelt down and said, "Reporting to the Pavilion Master, the mission has been successfully completed."
"Yes." The voice sounded again, "The protector is staying, you go down first."
"Yes."
Uncle Ji raised his hands to bow. After getting used to the light in the cave, he saw clearly that there was a dark figure sitting with his back to him, with a chessboard in front of him.
This person is the master of Shen Yuan Pavilion - Luo Shen Yuan.
After waiting for a long time, Luo Shenyuan didn't ask anything after several attempts. Ji Bo thought he was bored with waiting, so he just started to talk to himself.
Looking around, "Where did little Huairou go?"
Luo Chenyuan finally spoke: "What are you asking her for?"
"Just ask." Ji Boyi raised the corner of his mouth, "I haven't seen her for a long time. I miss her a little. I even brought her chestnut cakes when I went down the mountain."
"I have a temporary mission." Luo Chenyuan replied, and then asked: "Why didn't Guardian Zuo come back with you?"
"Did he go out?" Ji Boyi was confused for a moment, then quickly realized, "Tsk, he has a very strange temper. How can I control him?"
Falling into the abyss without saying a word.
Ji Boyi said, "Where did little Huairou go on a mission? I'll pick her up."
"No need to pick it up, I'm going to deliver something." Luo Shenyuan dropped a sigh.
